independent_verifier_source:
"""Independent stdlib-only verifier of the consumed management-tail capture."""
import argparse
import calendar
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat
import sys
import zipfile


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def parse(raw):
    def pairs(items):
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            require(key not in result, "duplicate JSON key")
            result[key] = value
        return result
    return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=pairs)


def sealed(raw):
    value = parse(raw)
    require(value["content_sha256"] == sha(canonical({k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "content_sha256"})), "content seal")
    return value


def timestamp(value):
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d)(?:\.(\d{1,9}))?\+00:00", value)
    require(match is not None, "canonical UTC nanosecond timestamp")
    whole = datetime.strptime(match[1], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    return calendar.timegm(whole.timetuple()) * 1_000_000_000 + int((match[2] or "").ljust(9, "0"))


def members(path, metadata, run):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    require(metadata["size_in_bytes"] == len(raw), "artifact byte size")
    require(metadata["digest"] == "sha256:" + sha(raw) and metadata["expired"] is False, "artifact digest or expiry")
    require(metadata["workflow_run"]["id"] == run["id"] and metadata["workflow_run"]["head_sha"] == run["head_sha"], "artifact run identity")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        require(len(names) == len(set(names)), "duplicate ZIP members")
        for info in archive.infolist():
            p = PurePosixPath(info.filename)
            require(not p.is_absolute() and ".." not in p.parts and "\\" not in info.filename, "unsafe archive path")
            require(not info.is_dir() and not info.flag_bits & 1 and not stat.S_ISLNK(info.external_attr >> 16), "unsafe archive member")
        return {name: archive.read(name) for name in names}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--capture", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--consumption", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--metadata", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    def deny(event, arguments):
        if event.startswith("socket.") or event in {"subprocess.Popen", "os.system", "os.exec", "os.fork", "os.posix_spawn"}:
            raise RuntimeError("independent verifier forbids external IO")
    sys.addaudithook(deny)
    meta = parse(args.metadata.read_bytes())
    run, job = meta["run"], meta["job"]
    contract_path = "research/strategy/sealed-historical-management-missing-input-acquisition-v0.1.json"
    contract = sealed((args.root / contract_path).read_bytes())
    execution = sealed((args.root / contract_path.replace(".json", "-execution.json")).read_bytes())
    require(run["head_sha"] == meta["execution_commit"]["sha"] and run["event"] == "push"
        and run["head_branch"] == "phase-3-historical-snapshot" and run["run_attempt"] == 1
        and run["status"] == "completed" and run["conclusion"] == "success", "exact first-attempt execution run")
    require(job["run_id"] == run["id"] and job["conclusion"] == "success", "exact capture job")
    require(all(s["conclusion"] == "success" for s in job["steps"]), "capture job step failed or skipped")
    names = [s["name"] for s in job["steps"]]
    require(names.index("Atomically consume this acquisition once") < names.index("Durably upload consumption before market-data access")
        < names.index("Capture only the ten exact missing management resources"), "durable ordering")
    require(len(meta["execution_commit"]["parents"]) == 1
        and meta["execution_commit"]["parents"][0]["sha"] == execution["code_commit_sha"], "execution parent")
    require(meta["code_commit"]["sha"] == execution["code_commit_sha"]
        and meta["code_commit"]["tree"]["sha"] == execution["code_tree_sha"], "tested code tree")
    require(meta["execution_commit"]["tree"]["sha"] == run["head_commit"]["tree_id"], "execution tree")
    require(meta["consumption_ref"]["ref"] == execution["consumption_ref"]
        and meta["consumption_ref"]["object"]["sha"] == run["head_sha"], "immutable consumption reference")
    for name, expected in contract["implementation_file_sha256"].items():
        require(sha((args.root / name).read_bytes()) == expected, "implementation pin: " + name)
    require(execution["contract_content_sha256"] == contract["content_sha256"], "execution contract")
    requirements = sealed((args.root / contract["missing_requirements_path"]).read_bytes())
    requests = contract["requests"]
    require(canonical(requests) == canonical(requirements["requests"]) and len(requests) == 10, "exact ten frozen requests")
    require(sha(canonical(requests)) == contract["request_manifest_sha256"], "request manifest")
    capture = members(args.capture, meta["capture_artifact"], run)
    preflight = members(args.consumption, meta["consumption_artifact"], run)
    require(set(preflight) == {"consumption-ref.json", "consumption.json", "source-validation.json", "pip-freeze.txt", "python-version.txt", "requirements.txt"}, "preflight file set")
    require(preflight["python-version.txt"].strip() == b"Python 3.12.14", "hosted Python version")
    require(preflight["requirements.txt"] == (args.root / "requirements-sealed-execution-quote-v01.txt").read_bytes(), "frozen package lock")
    require(parse(preflight["consumption-ref.json"])["object"]["sha"] == run["head_sha"], "pre-provider consumption")
    for name in ("consumption.json", "source-validation.json"):
        require(canonical(sealed(capture[name])) == canonical(sealed(preflight[name])), "preflight/capture identity")
    source_receipt = sealed(capture["source-validation.json"])
    prior_audit = "research/data-audits/sealed-historical-management-source-reuse-v0.1-independent-verification.json"
    require(sha((args.root / prior_audit).read_bytes()) == contract["reuse_audit_file_sha256"]
        == source_receipt["reuse_audit_file_sha256"], "verified reuse audit bytes")
    audit = sealed((args.root / prior_audit).read_bytes())
    require(canonical(audit["independent_verification"]["file_inventory"])
        == canonical(source_receipt["reuse_result_file_inventory"]), "reuse result inventory")
    for name, expected in source_receipt["reuse_result_file_inventory"].items():
        raw = (args.root / "research/runtime/sealed-historical-management-source-reuse-v0.1" / name).read_bytes()
        require(len(raw) == expected["bytes"] and sha(raw) == expected["sha256"], "exact committed reuse result")
    require(source_receipt["verified_reuse_result"] is True
        and source_receipt["original_source_archives_reopened_in_this_preflight"] is False
        and source_receipt["reuse_manifest_content_sha256"] == audit["freeze_manifest_content_sha256"], "reuse preflight attestation")
    marker = sealed(capture["consumption.json"])
    require(marker["execution_commit_sha"] == run["head_sha"] and marker["workflow_run_id"] == str(run["id"])
        and marker["workflow_run_attempt"] == 1 and marker["execution_content_sha256"] == execution["content_sha256"], "consumption seal identity")
    require(canonical(sealed(capture["contract.json"])) == canonical(contract), "captured contract")
    require(canonical(sealed(capture["execution.json"])) == canonical(execution), "captured execution")
    require(canonical(sealed(capture["requests.json"])["requests"]) == canonical(requests), "captured request set")
    inventory = sealed(capture["capture-inventory.json"])
    require(set(inventory["files"]) == set(capture) - {"capture-inventory.json"}, "complete file inventory")
    for name, expected in inventory["files"].items():
        require(sha(capture[name]) == expected, "member digest: " + name)
    report, ledger = sealed(capture["capture-report.json"]), parse(capture["request-ledger.json"])
    require(report["status"] == "complete" and report["logical_requests_completed"] == 10
        and inventory["complete"] is True and len(capture) == 28, "complete capture")
    receipts, expected_events, total_bytes = [], [], 0
    by_kind = Counter()
    for request in requests:
        path = f"dates/{request['trading_date']}/{request['symbol']}-{request['kind']}.jsonl.gz"
        receipt = sealed(capture["receipts/" + request["request_id"] + ".json"])
        compressed = capture[path]
        raw = gzip.decompress(compressed)
        require(receipt["path"] == path and receipt["request_id"] == request["request_id"], "receipt identity")
        require(receipt["file_sha256"] == sha(compressed) and receipt["logical_sha256"] == sha(raw), "tape digests")
        lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
        require(len(lines) == receipt["record_count"] and receipt["complete"] is True
            and receipt["empty_exhausted_segment"] is (len(lines) == 0), "exhausted receipt")
        require(type(receipt["pages"]) is int and 1 <= receipt["pages"] <= 512 and len(lines) <= receipt["pages"] * 10_000, "pagination bound")
        previous, tied = None, set()
        for ordinal, line in enumerate(lines):
            value = parse(line)
            require(canonical(value) + b"\n" == line and len(line) <= 1000, "canonical row")
            stamp = timestamp(value["t"])
            require(request["start_ns"] <= stamp < request["end_ns"] and (previous is None or stamp >= previous), "causal interval/order")
            if stamp != previous:
                tied.clear()
            require(line not in tied, "repeated normalized record")
            tied.add(line)
            if request["kind"] == "sip_trades":
                require(set(value) == {"t", "p", "s", "i", "x", "z", "c"}, "trade schema")
                require(type(value["p"]) is float and math.isfinite(value["p"]) and value["p"] > 0, "trade price")
                require(all(type(value[k]) is int and value[k] >= 0 for k in ("s", "i")), "trade integers")
                require(isinstance(value["x"], str) and len(value["x"]) == 1 and value["z"] in {"A", "B", "C"}, "exchange/tape")
                require(isinstance(value["c"], list) and all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) <= 2 for c in value["c"]), "trade conditions")
            else:
                require(set(value) == {"t", "o", "h", "l", "c", "v", "n", "vw"}, "bar schema")
                require(stamp % 60_000_000_000 == 0 and stamp != previous, "minute identity")
                require(all(type(value[k]) is float and math.isfinite(value[k]) and value[k] > 0 for k in ("o", "h", "l", "c", "vw")), "bar prices")
                require(all(type(value[k]) is int and value[k] >= 0 for k in ("v", "n")), "bar integers")
                require(value["l"] <= min(value["o"], value["c"]) <= max(value["o"], value["c"]) <= value["h"], "OHLC order")
            previous = stamp
        require(receipt["retained_bytes"] == len(compressed), "compressed tape size")
        total_bytes += len(compressed)
        by_kind[request["kind"]] += len(lines)
        receipts.append({k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k != "content_sha256"})
        for _ in range(receipt["pages"]):
            expected_events.append({"attempt": len(expected_events) + 1, "request_id": request["request_id"]})
    attempts = len(expected_events)
    require(canonical(receipts) == canonical(report["receipts"]), "report receipts")
    require(ledger["attempt_events"] == expected_events and ledger["by_request"] == dict(Counter(e["request_id"] for e in expected_events)), "exact attempt accounting")
    require(ledger["by_host"] == {"data.alpaca.markets": attempts} and ledger["total_attempts"] == attempts
        and inventory["provider_attempts"] == attempts and ledger["blocked_attempts"] == inventory["blocked_attempts"] == 0
        and attempts <= 512, "provider attempt ceilings")
    require(total_bytes == report["normalized_compressed_bytes"] and total_bytes <= 100_000_000, "shared compressed-byte ceiling")
    for key in ("backtesting_executed", "account_or_fill_simulation_executed", "management_projection_executed", "policy_changed", "retrospective_inputs_loaded", "portfolio_financial_metrics_eligible"):
        require(report[key] is False and inventory[key] is False, "closed gate: " + key)
    result = {"verification_passed": True, "verifier": "independent_stdlib_no_runtime_imports",
        "execution_commit_sha": run["head_sha"], "run_id": run["id"], "run_attempt": 1,
        "capture_zip_sha256": sha(args.capture.read_bytes()), "consumption_zip_sha256": sha(args.consumption.read_bytes()),
        "verified_capture_files": len(capture), "verified_consumption_files": len(preflight),
        "verified_logical_requests": 10, "normalized_row_count": sum(by_kind.values()), "rows_by_kind": dict(by_kind),
        "empty_exhausted_segments": sum(r["empty_exhausted_segment"] for r in receipts),
        "provider_attempts": attempts, "blocked_attempts": 0, "normalized_compressed_bytes": total_bytes,
        "receipts": receipts, "capture_file_inventory": {n: {"bytes": len(b), "sha256": sha(b)} for n, b in capture.items()},
        "consumption_file_inventory": {n: {"bytes": len(b), "sha256": sha(b)} for n, b in preflight.items()},
        "unavailable_entry_opportunities_preserved": 23, "provider_calls_by_verifier": 0,
        "account_or_fill_simulation_executed": False, "backtesting_executed": False}
    print(json.dumps({**result, "content_sha256": sha(canonical(result))}, sort_keys=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
